newsitem.title: USA: CDW Computer files secondary stock offer.
newsitem.headline: CDW Computer files secondary stock offer.

text.p: CDW Computer Centers Inc. filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a secondary offering of 500,000 common shares in addition to 132,064 shares being offered by other employees that were previously registered with the agency.
Of the newly registered shares, 363,563 are being sold by company Chairman Michael Krasny, whose total stake will decline after the offering to 56.6 percent from 59.5 percent, CDW said.
Among those offering the rest of the shares are other executives, including company President Gregory Zeman, who is selling 103,504 shares, it said.
An underwriting group led by William Blair & Co. has an option to buy an additional 50,000 shares, the company said.
